title: JPM’s Michele Tells US Treasury ‘Get Rid of the 20-Year’

He speaks on “Bloomberg Surveillance.” (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Onshore Yuan Snaps Winning Streak as PBOC Lifts FX Reserve Ratio
summary: The onshore yuan halted its longest winning streak in three decades after the People’s Bank of China moved to cool its rally by asking banks to hold more foreign currencies in reserve.

title: Simandou Offsets Iron Ore Supply Cuts Elsewhere, Macquarie Says
